description: Use this when the user asks for live electricity grid data for one grid: a US ISO, TVA, BPA, a US utility BA, Canada (IESO, AESO, HYDROQUEBEC), GB (NGESO), an ENTSO-E zone (EU_DE_LU), Taiwan, Japan, South Korea, Brazil, Australia or Singapore: fuel mix and demand.

iso.description: Grid code (required): a US ISO (ERCOT, PJM, MISO, CAISO, SPP, NYISO, ISONE), TVA, BPA, a utility BA or city (AZPS, PHOENIX), or a non-US grid (IESO, AESO, HYDROQUEBEC, NGESO, EU_DE_LU, TAIPOWER, OCCTO, KEPCO-KR, ONS, AEMO, EMA)

metric.description: Optional metric focus, e.g. fuel_mix, demand, demand_curve

period.description: Optional time window for the metric, e.g. 24h

name: get_grid_data
title: Live Grid Data
